sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Retail of Desktop 3D Printers and Resin Filaments

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Panama (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate registry)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: civil law foundation (Roman-French tradition) with U.S.-derived corporate statutes (Ley 32 de 1927); unitary national system
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA), investment chapter in force since 31 October 2012
Panama–Canada Free Trade Agreement, in force since 1 April 2013
Panama–United Kingdom Double Taxation Convention, active

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT framework, as amended); Decreto de Gabinete No. 108 de 25 de junio de 2018 (creation and reorganization of the Unidad de Análisis Financiero — UAF); Ley No. 129 de 7 de octubre de 2020 (creation of the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales — RBF at the Registro Público); Ley No. 254 de 24 de octubre de 2021 (creation of the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros — SSNF, with oversight over designated non-financial businesses and professions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the incorporation instrument (Articles of Association / Certificate of Incorporation) of each corporate shareholder, together with current directors and officers list
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry in the shareholder's country of origin (e.g., Secretary of State, Companies House, Registro Mercantil)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (HCCH 1961 Convention) or consular legalization for non-member states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Corporate Solvency (paz y salvo) of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry, tax authority, or designated issuing body

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copy and proof of residential address for each natural-person shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or recognized KYC certification authority in the UBO's country of residence or citizenship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization where a notarial certification chain is required

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 (Sociedades Anonimas), as amended, Arts. 1 (formation by public deed), 2 (mandatory deed content), 3 (capital and shares), 9 (registered office and resident agent); Codigo de Comercio (general commercial record); Decreto Ejecutivo 132 de 2018 (electronic filing procedures)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Publico de Panama (RPAP) - Direccion General de Registro de Personas Juridicas; online portal: portal.registropublico.gob.pa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Publica de Constitucion / Pacto Social (Public Deed of Incorporation) with corporate By-Laws (Estatutos)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Ley 32 de 1927; capital may be expressed in any currency and no escrow deposit or paid-in verification is required at incorporation. For bank and payment-processor (Stripe/Shopify) onboarding, an authorized capital of US$10,000.00 represented by 100 shares is recommended.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the authorized capital of the Company be fixed at US$10,000.00 divided into 100 common shares of US$100.00 par value each, and the subscription of the founding shareholder be accepted. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office be established in Panama City, Republic of Panama, under the care of the Resident Agent. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following officers be appointed: President, Secretary, and Treasurer, each to serve until successors are duly elected. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the officers be authorized to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and complete all formalities to commence operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Availability Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Publico de Panama (RPAP) - Online Name Reservation System (Sistema de Reserva de Nombre)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application reserving the proposed corporate name for a Sociedad Anonima; pay the reservation fee electronically; the system issues a Certificate of Name Reservation valid for 30 business days, renewable once for a further 30 days.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name (up to 3 alternatives)
Copy of applicant passport
Proof of payment of reservation fee
Basic corporate purpose declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is flagged as identical or confusingly similar, submit a substitute name online within the validity window or appeal to the Direccion General de Registro de Personas Juridicas with a written petition distinguishing the marks.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution and Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panama Notary Public (Notaria Novena del Circuito de Panama or any licensed notary) together with the law firm acting as Resident Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct counsel to draft the Pacto Social and Estatutos in Spanish; all founding subscribers execute the deed before the notary; the notary authenticates signatures and issues the certified original (testimonio) and private copies for the registry, DGI and banking use.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate
Itemized list of founders with passport copies
Proposed registered office address in Panama
Appointment acceptance letter from Resident Agent
Draft By-Laws including ISIC 4791 e-commerce object clauses
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or counsel detects omissions (missing object clause, capital data or agent acceptance), execute an addendum (aclaracion) deed and re-notarize before incurring registry fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription of the Corporation with the Public Registry of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Publico de Panama - Personas Juridicas Section; electronic submission window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the testimonio together with the registration request and proof of payment of the corporate stamp tax and registry fee; RPAP conducts substantive review and grants legal personality upon inscription; obtain the Certificado de Inscripcion / Personeria Juridica.
required_dossiers: First notarial copy of Escritura Publica
Name reservation certificate
Proof of payment of B/.250 registry fee and stamp taxes
Digital copy uploaded via RPAP e-filing module
Power of attorney to filing agent (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the inscription is objected (prevencion), correct observations within the 10-business-day term by certified note or supplementary notarial deed; if refused, appeal to the Registrador General and re-file with cured defects.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration - RUC (Registro Unico de Contribuyente) with DGI
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direccion General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance; online via e-Tax (etax.mef.gob.pa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete RUC registration in Spanish selecting fiscal activity 4791 (retail sale via mail order or internet); declare fiscal domicile in Panama; upload the registered deed and officer details; receive the RUC certificate as prerequisite for municipal licensing and bank account opening.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Personeria Juridica
Copy of registered Escritura Publica
Passport copies of legal representatives and Resident Agent cedula
Completed DGI registration form
Proof of fiscal domicile (lease or title)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI rejects the activity code or address, re-submit an amended e-Tax form with supporting evidence; late registration fines up to B/.500 may be reduced via voluntary compliance request before assessment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating License - Aviso de Operacion
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipalidad de Panama (Alcaldia de Panama) - Ventanilla Unica / Digital Notice of Operation platform, or the municipality of the registered address
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Aviso de Operacion application for e-commerce retail; compute municipal tax based on declared annual gross revenue bracket; obtain the operational license, which for online merchants still requires clearance of the physical office or warehouse domicile.
required_dossiers: RUC certificate
Personeria Juridica certificate
Tenancy agreement or deed proving physical domicile
Fire inspection report or provisional certificate
Completed municipal Aviso de Operacion form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Municipal queries on revenue bands may be answered with certified financial projections; if denied, file an appeal (recurso de apelacion) before the Municipal Council within five business days or re-apply with corrected commercial classification codes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening, Fiscal Agent Confirmation and Governance Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Panamanian bank (e.g. Banistmo, Global Bank, Bancolombia Panama) and DGI fiscal compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking account with full KYC/AML documentation; appoint or confirm the Resident Agent and tax representative; activate the annual franchise tax regime (B/.300) and file the annual fee; execute signatory resolutions for Stripe and Shopify Payments settlement accounts.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Good Standing / Personeria Juridica
Reviewed Statutes and Deed
Director and officer KYC (passports, bank references)
Corporate resolution naming signatories and fiscal year
Resident Agent acceptance and tax return authorization
Beneficial ownership declaration per Ley 23 de 2015 AML rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional substance evidence, provide a business plan and revenue projections for the 3D-printer e-commerce operations; if the franchise tax is missed, file voluntarily with late surcharge and obtain a compliance letter from DGI.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) - Direccion Nacional de Comercio for general merchant registration only; no sectoral manufacturing board applies because the activity is online retail and re-dispatch of desktop 3D printers and resin consumables
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operacion (Municipal Notice of Operation) for Class 1 online retail, with supplementary MICI merchant registration if the entity directly imports 3D printer consumables

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Direccion de Evaluacion Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Categoria I, Lista I (retail trade, no industrial transformation); full Estudio de Impacto Ambiental not required for an e-commerce warehouse provided no resin manufacturing, blending or 3D printing production occurs on site; a short environmental registration checklist may apply for larger storage facilities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC thresholds apply for pure retail; handling of opened photopolymer resins must comply with Decreto Ejecutivo 5 de 2009 air-quality rules and Ley 1 de 2019 comprehensive waste management for resin residues; take-back and transboundary e-waste obligations for printers, batteries and electronic accessories follow Law 33 de 2018 (WEEE equivalent), including importer registration with MiAMBIENTE and MICI.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panama fire-safety inspection and certificate for any office or warehouse; Direccion General de Salud (MINSA-DIGESA) occupational hygiene and sanitation clearance; municipal Visto Bueno de Uso confirming structural load capacity and compliance with the National Building Code for the storage facility.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas de Panamá; official portal: https://dgi.mef.gob.pa (Oficina Virtual DGI).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity obtains a Panama tax identification number (RUC - Registro Único de Contribuyente) by filing the DGI taxpayer registration application through a licensed Panamanian attorney or the entity's resident agent. Required supporting documents include the notarized Escritura Pública (public deed of incorporation), the certificate of registration from the Registro Público de Panamá, and evidence of any Panama operational address and/or local bank account. If the entity will import goods or make taxable supplies in Panama, the same application includes ITBMS registration. The DGI assigns a provisional RUC immediately and finalizes the file once the taxpayer begins activities. A non-resident corporation without Panama-source income or imports should still maintain a resident agent but is not required to maintain an active RUC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not applicable. Panama does not have check-the-box elections, pass-through elections, or hybrid mismatch election mechanisms. Sociedades Anónimas are automatically taxed as separate corporate taxpayers at the entity level. A taxpayer may elect to apply special investment or headquarters regimes (e.g., SEM Law 41 of 2007) based on their business plan, but such an election does not alter the corporate tax classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios) - Panama's VAT
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: B/.36,000 per fiscal year (approximately USD 36,000) in taxable gross sales. Importers of taxable goods and exporters claiming zero-rating must register regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama requires all DGI-registered taxpayers to issue electronic invoices through DGI-certified software or the DGI-hosted portal. Invoices must be transmitted in real time via API/XML to the DGI's Sistema de Facturación Electrónica (SFE) for digital validation; each invoice is stamped with a DGI-authorized folio, a digital code (Código de Autorización) and QR code before the transaction is considered valid for tax purposes. Only SFE-cleared invoices grant ITBMS input tax credits. The DGI also requires daily transmission of fiscal data for medium and large taxpayers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for goods that are definitively exported from Panama and for services supplied to recipients outside Panama or consumed outside Panama when such services are not related to Panamanian real estate or tangible property. The exporter must be legally registered for ITBMS, must issue a 0% electronic invoice through the SFE, and must retain evidence that the goods physically left Panama or that the services were used abroad. Transactions not evidenced in this manner are reclassified as domestic taxable sales at 7%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Única Aduanera - DUA) with the corresponding export chapter
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing actual physical exit from Panama
Commercial invoice showing the 0% ITBMS rate and reference to export
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/MT103 credit advice proving receipt of foreign currency
Certificate of Origin (if requested by the buyer or for tariff benefit)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI audit examinations for zero-rated exports will cross-match the electronic invoice tax data, customs exit records, shipping manifests, and bank currency receipts. If the documentary chain is incomplete or inconsistent, the DGI may retroactively assess the full 7% ITBMS on the transaction, plus monthly default interest and late-payment surcharges. Fines for tax fraud and non-compliance can range from 50% to 200% of the tax evaded; criminal penalties for falsifying export documentation can include imprisonment under Panama's Tax Code and Criminal Code. The taxpayer may also face suspension of the RUC, prohibition on issuing zero-rated invoices, and enhanced audit monitoring for subsequent periods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) as banking supervisor; Banco Nacional de Panamá as fiscal agent; no issuing central bank exists because Panama is fully dollarized with the U.S. dollar as legal tender.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama maintains full convertibility for both current and capital account transactions since the U.S. dollar is the national currency. There is no separate panamanian currency and no foreign exchange law restricting the conversion of funds. Profit remittances, dividend distributions, and capital repatriation are freely executable through the commercial banking system, subject only to standard tax verification, beneficial ownership disclosure, and anti-money laundering source-of-funds checks. Non-resident shareholders may receive wire transfers without exchange-control approval, and there are no withholding friction points specifically attributable to foreign exchange restrictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory export proceeds surrender requirements, no mandatory conversion ratios, and no obligation to repatriate export collections through a designated central bank window. Export receipts may be retained in U.S. dollars, used directly for operational disbursements, or transferred abroad. The only compliance duties are the general commercial invoice record-keeping, tax territorial-source filing, and suspicious-transaction reporting obligations applicable under Panama's banking and anti-money laundering regime.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low direct viability. Panama's Banking Law does not grant foreign fintech electronic money institutions or digital EMIs a standalone banking licence or direct access to the local clearing house. A foreign EMI may operate only as a payment facilitator through a partnership with a fully licensed Panama commercial bank, which must hold the settlement account, conduct KYC on the ultimate beneficiary, and assume transaction-monitoring responsibility. For an online 3D printer and resin filament retailer, using U.S.-based payment rails such as Stripe or Shopify Payments is operationally viable for card acceptance, but treasury liquidity for local supplier payments and tax obligations should be held in a regulated Panama commercial bank rather than an unlicensed EMI.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote-only account opening is generally unavailable for a non-resident-owned Panama S.A. under standard AML policies. At least one director or authorized signatory is normally required to complete an in-person or bank-approved videoconference interview at a Panama branch or, for select private banks, at the bank's Miami or international representative office. The bank initially reviews apostilled certificate of incorporation, corporate bylaws, directors' resolutions, current officers' registry, passport copies, utility bills, and professional references. For lower-risk e-commerce structures, some banks permit a single natural-person director to appear in person while other directors execute powers-of-attorney through apostilled documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undisclosed beneficial ownership or historical bearer-share ambiguity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current certificado de registro and fiches from Registro Público; complete UBO chain declaration through Panama's beneficial ownership registry; certified resolution waiving bearer shares and confirming registered share transfers; apostilled passports and proof of residence for every direct and indirect owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Corporate structure with no visible local substance or real business activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed office lease in Panama or evidence of virtual office arrangement with licensed service provider; employment contracts or payroll records for local personnel; principal distributor agreements for 3D printers and filaments; transactional evidence from marketplace platforms; board minutes showing treasury decisions and commercial contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth and source-of-funds insufficiency for initial capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank reference letter from the originating bank; audited or reviewed financial statements for the consolidated legal entity; corporate tax returns for operating parents; invoice for shareholder subscription and proof of payment path through the same shareholder's bank account; public accounting firm attestation of economic substance and lawful revenue.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions-screening or adverse-media matches among counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Once-cleared OFAC, EU, UN, and local PEP listing screens for all directors, shareholders, and significant counterparties; written sanctions-compliance manual; screenshot or log audit trail of continuous screening; explanation of any innocent-name matches; supplier identification documents for the filament and machinery import chain.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity or shareholder-loan funding is routed over the U.S. dollar wholesale network using SWIFT MT103 wire instructions from the originating bank to the Panama commercial bank. The wire beneficiary must match exactly the registered legal entity name and the account number, with the field 70 remittance reference stating 'Capital Contribution per Resolution [date]' or 'Paid-in Capital'. No Central Bank authorization or foreign exchange form is required because Panama is fully dollarized. The receiving bank will apply its expanded due-diligence protocol, requiring source-of-funds evidence, beneficial ownership certification, and a copy of the corporate director resolution authorizing the capital inflow. Settlement in USD is normally same-day or next-day depending on the U.S. correspondent bank cut-off.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational trade settlements to manufacturers in China, the United States, the European Union, or Latin America are executed as SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers from the Panama treasury account. For large purchase orders of resin filaments, extruders, and 3D printer components, buyers can utilize SWIFT MT700 documentary letters of credit issued through the Panama bank, with the Chinese seller's negotiation bank acting as confirming beneficiary. Domestic payables inside Panama clear electronically through the local ACH system known as SICAP or through same-day wire transfers in U.S. dollars. Card settlement proceeds from Stripe, Shopify Payments, or similar acquiring platforms are batched in USD and directed to the primary Panama operational account, thereby avoiding currency conversion and reducing settlement spread.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-deliverable forwards restricted to currencies of non-dollarized Latin American counterparties; not applicable to the Panama USD operating book
Deliverable forwards between USD and CNY or USD and EUR for confirmed future supplier invoices
Cross-currency swaps for medium-term financing of imported 3D printer equipment or long-term raw-material purchase contracts
Plain-vanilla foreign exchange options for natural-currency exposure on non-USD receivables, subject to bank credit approval
Zero-cost collar structures combining a purchased call and sold put where underlying exposure exceeds USD 250,000 per transaction

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual franchise tax (Impuesto Anual de la Tasa Única)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment generates a surcharge of 10% of the tax due plus monthly interest on arrears; failure to pay for two consecutive years may lead to suspension of the corporation's rights in the public registry and initiation of administrative strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited or unaudited financial statements (Estados Financieros Anuales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after close of the fiscal year (e.g., by March 31 for a December 31 year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to register financial statements results in a fine of up to USD 500.00 and may block issuance of certificates of good standing; persistent default can trigger administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial ownership confirmation (Declaración Anual de Accionistas y Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent (acting as keeper of the legal and UBO records)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than December 31 of each year covering all intervening ownership changes; in practice aligned with the March 31 annual corporate filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or confirm UBO records with the registered agent constitutes an administrative violation under Law 23 of 2015, exposing the entity and officers to fines between USD 500.00 and USD 5,000.00 for each omission.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit is required for public-interest entities, financial licensees, and corporations with gross annual income exceeding USD 1,000,000.00 or total assets exceeding USD 3,000,000.00; typical online retail S.A. transactions below these thresholds may file unaudited financial statements prepared in accordance with the Panamanian Economic Activities Regulations.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Panama GAAP / IFRS for SMEs as adopted by the local College of Public Accountants; general-purpose financial statements of larger entities may apply full IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every share transfer or beneficial ownership change must be communicated to the registered agent within 30 days; the agent updates the internal UBO register and documents the annual confirmation in the minutes booklet. Annual filing of the franchise tax includes a sworn declaration that the UBO records are complete and accurate as of the end of the fiscal year.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Beneficial Owners (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No preferential statutory holiday or reduced effective rate for an ordinary online retail Sociedad Anónima. Panama applies territorial taxation: only Panama-source income is chargeable. Foreign-source income may be excluded if commercially documented. Special regimes (e.g., export-processing/SEM zones) can provide reduced or exempt treatment, but they are not assumed in this default e-commerce structure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 745 (Declaración Jurada Anual de Rentas de Personas Jurídicas); filed electronically through the DGI (Dirección General de Ingresos) portal of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; quarterly advance corporate income tax payments may be required during the fiscal year
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than 31 March immediately following the close of the fiscal year, which is the three-month statutory period after the fiscal year-end. The standard fiscal year ends on 31 December.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Panama Unique Taxpayer Registry Number assigned to the legal entity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Panama RUC obtained by the resident agent during incorporation; do not use the foreign tax identification number of the beneficial owner.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax period covered by the return, in the format DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the fiscal year registered with the DGI; for a default entity this is the calendar year ending 31 December. Non-residents may apply for a different year-end only with prior DGI approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line A – Ingresos brutos de fuente panameña
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross Panama-source revenue, including online retail sales to customers in Panama
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include sales delivered to Panamanian territory or paid by Panamanian customers through payment rails such as Stripe or Shopify Payments. Exclude foreign-source sales only if logistics and payment records clearly evidence export from or delivery outside Panama.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line B – Costos de venta y gastos deducibles
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold, logistics, cloud-platform fees, payment-processor fees, and other legally deductible operating expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions must be supported by physical or electronic invoices, contracts, and bank records. Expenses invoiced by related parties are deductible only if substantiated at arm's length and supported by transfer pricing documentation when applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross Panama-source income minus allowable deductions and any available statutory loss carryforward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute conservatively; net operating losses may be carried forward only for the five allowed years and must be traceable in prior-year returns. If a loss is claimed, be prepared to produce the source-year records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax resulting from applying the 25% headline rate to net taxable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the statutory 25% rate. If the entity has a net tax loss, enter zero but attach the calculation of the loss for future carryforward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line E – Retenciones y pagos anticipados
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for Panama withholding taxes and quarterly advance income tax payments already settled during the fiscal year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter only Panamanian tax credits. Foreign taxes do not reduce Panama corporate income tax in this territorial system.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line F – Impuesto por pagar o saldo a favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net balance due or refundable tax position after applying credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The net tax due must be paid through DGI channels on or before the filing deadline. Overpayments are first credited against future liabilities, not automatically refunded to non-resident shareholders.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a DGI procedural fine of B/.500 to B/.10,000, a 10% automatic surcharge on unpaid tax, statutory default interest, and possible suspension of fiscal standing. Under-reporting or failure to file despite taxable income can result in additional assessment of 100% of the omitted tax plus criminal penalties if fraudulent intent is shown.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% general withholding rate on dividends paid from profits that have been subject to Panamanian corporate income tax. A supplementary 15% tax may apply to distributions out of profits not previously taxed, subject to statutory reconciliation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a lower DTA rate, the shareholder must prove beneficial ownership and submit to the Panamanian payer and the DGI a current Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the shareholder's residence tax authority, together with the applicable DTA relief request form (Solicitud de Aplicación de CDI). The DGI must approve or reject the request before the distribution date; upon approval, the payer applies the treaty rate. Non-treaty residents bear the full statutory 10% withholding, which is final and must be remitted through DGI e-filing within five banking days of distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for the use of intangible property from Panama: statutory withholding 12.5%, reduced by applicable DTA provisions to approximately 5%–10% when the payee is resident with beneficial ownership. Interest paid to non-resident lenders for Panama-source debt: statutory withholding 6%, with DTA-reduced rates of 4%–5% available upon submission of TRC and beneficial-ownership evidence.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File (Estudio de Precios de Transferencia) and annual TP information return when aggregate controlled transactions with related parties exceed B/.1,000,000 in a fiscal year. A Master File is required when the multinational group's worldwide consolidated revenue exceeds B/.50,000,000. Amounts are expressed in Panamanian Balboas (B/.), at par with the United States dollar.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Rules apply to resident entities carrying on relevant activities, which include e-commerce and distribution. The S.A. must maintain a physical office, local decision-making functions, employees, and adequate expenditures in Panama, or otherwise evidence commercial purpose satisfying local substance. Non-compliance removes eligibility for a tax-residence certificate and attracts fines up to B/.1,000,000, in addition to possible dissolution for sham entities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Treating Panama-destination online sales as non-Panama-source income; routing consumer payments through a foreign merchant account to conceal revenue; or omitting gross receipts in Form 745 with the intent to evade the 25% corporate income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative re-assessment with surcharge of up to 100% of omitted tax, monthly default interest, monetary fines of up to five times the evaded amount, and criminal tax fraud liability under Law 254 of 2021 carrying imprisonment of three to five years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false sworn tax returns are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax; they may face travel bans, passport surrender, asset seizure, and criminal prosecution even when the S.A. remains nominally valid.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the S.A. solely as an invoice pass-through with no physical office, no employees, no bank account in Panama, and no local supply-chain or management substance, while claiming Panamanian tax residence for foreign activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Panama's ESR framework, a relevant activity conducted without substance carries fines from B/.50,000 to B/.1,000,000, cancellation of tax-residence status, loss of fiscal domicile benefits, and administrative dissolution or deregistration of the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors and the resident agent may be held accountable; directors may be disqualified from serving, subjected to asset freezes and civil restitution orders, and, if conspiracy is shown, prosecuted criminally.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing and Missing Documentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Buying filaments, resins, or printers from a related offshore intermediary at fabricated markups; failing to file the TP information return; or failing to prepare a Local File when controlled transactions exceed the B/.1,000,000 threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The DGI may adjust prices to the arm's length result, recompute Panamanian tax at 25%, impose an understatement penalty between 15% and 50%, and charge default interest. Falsified documentation triggers criminal fraud investigation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approved non-arm's length arrangements risk personal liability through veil-piercing, seizure of personal assets, ineligibility to manage Panamanian companies, and extradition to Panama if they are resident abroad.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Hiding the ultimate beneficial owner behind bearer shares or nominees; failing to file or update the Panama beneficial ownership registry; or accepting untraceable third-party payments not supported by genuine customer transactions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law 23 of 2015 and related AML/CFT provisions, fines against the company may reach B/.5,000,000; assets linked to money laundering are subject to confiscation; the underlying tax offense converts illicit gains to laundered property, carrying imprisonment of five to ten years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, officers, and beneficial owners are personally liable for AML compliance failures. Sanctions include asset freezing, travel restrictions, criminal prosecution, and, for foreign directors, arrest through Interpol circular if they attempt to enter Panama or treaty jurisdictions.
